headline: "Independence and technical rigor, the profile the successor to Heath at Banxico should have"
summary: Analysts from Bankaool, BNP Paribas, Finamex and UBS said the candidate to replace Jonathan Heath on Banco de México's board should show independence, technical rigor and monetary policy experience.
why: Banco de México sets Mexico's monetary policy, and board appointments shape the direction of its interest rate decisions. Investors follow these changes for their effect on peso assets and Mexican rates.
original_headline: “Independencia y rigor técnico, el perfil que debe tener el relevo de Heath en Banxico”
